items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC6 each covered by a test; spec-reviewer PASS in round 2.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Detector returns null on non-text/oversize content; elapsed time degrades to the bare verb on bad timestamps; empty report still renders the notice card.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: All report/message text goes through MarkdownChunk (no raw HTML); PR link only for https URLs with noopener; read-only on the JSONL.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real on-disk fixture shapes, negative cases (quoting human text, tool_result, mixed cards), CSS fence, real-browser E2E for all three surfaces.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Grouping is one memoised O(n) pass per feed; detector is a few string ops per user record.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New code in small cohesive files (<110 lines); session-parser.ts shrank 842 to 775 via extraction.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: Claude CLI transcript user-role records; consumer: session-parser then feed/BubbleTranscript/narrator. Probed with real on-disk record shapes (hand-back envelope + trailer) and an E2E through the real JSONL to DOM chain.
